title: Adapting Large Language Models to Low-Resource Tibetan: A Two-Stage Continual and Supervised Fine-Tuning Study
abstract: arXiv:2512.03976v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to low-resource languages remains a major challenge due to data scarcity and cross-lingual drift. This work presents a two-stage adaptation of Qwen2.5-3B to Tibetan, a morphologically rich and underrepresented language. We employ Continual Pretraining (CPT) to establish Tibetan linguistic grounding, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for task and translation specialization. translated_title: 将大型语言模型适配至低资源藏语：一项两阶段持续预训练与监督微调研究
translated_abstract: 由于数据稀缺和跨语言漂移，将大型语言模型（LLM）适配到低资源语言仍然是一项重大挑战。本工作展示了对 Qwen2.5-3B 进行藏语适配的两阶段方法，藏语是一种形态丰富但代表性不足的语言。我们首先采用持续预训练（CPT）建立藏语的语言基础，随后进行监督微调（SFT）以实现任务与翻译能力的专门化。实证评估表明，模型困惑度持续下降（从 2.98 降至 1.54），汉译藏翻译质量显著提升（BLEU：0.046 → 0.261；chrF：2.2 → 6.6）。针对 Qwen3-4B 全部 435 层的逐层分析显示，适配主要集中于嵌入层和输出头，而中后期的 MLP 投影则编码了领域特定的变换。我们的研究结果表明，CPT 构建了藏语的语义流形，而 SFT 则在此基础上进一步……
tldr: 该研究提出持续预训练加监督微调的两阶段策略，将 Qwen2.5-3B 成功适配到低资源藏语，显著降低困惑度并大幅提升汉藏翻译质量，同时揭示适配主要集中在嵌入层、输出头及中后期 MLP 层。
en_tdlr: This study adapts Qwen2.5-3B to low-resource Tibetan through a two-stage pipeline of continual pretraining and supervised fine-tuning, substantially reducing perplexity and improving Chinese-to-Tibetan translation, while revealing that adaptation concentrates on embeddings, output heads, and mid-late MLP layers.
